Proposals.Development: Adrian survives a catastrophic accident involving massive internal bleeding and organ damage, is saved by programmable medical nanites that interact with the fertility drug to create an evolving artificial organism, and explicitly commits to continuing the trial and undergoing additional tests to monitor the nanites.
Proposals.Evidence: "Okay," he said, his voice still hoarse but stronger than before. "I'll continue. I'll do the tests. Whatever you need."
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: Adrian has survived the catastrophic accident and the nanite intervention, is now a host to an evolving artificial organism, and has committed to continuing the trial and undergoing additional monitoring tests.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Adrian undergoes the additional extensive tests and genetic panel to monitor the nanites' interaction with his biology and the fertility drug, while managing the accelerated metabolic strain on his body.
